verdict.rationale: YYLO documents operator-invoked automation: `yy loop` repeats commands, Workflow Runner chains steps, run-until-completion iterates over kanban work, and integrations pull Slack or GitHub items into kanban. None of these is a user-defined rule that fires an action automatically when an event occurs, so they are adjacent features rather than an event-trigger rule capability. The Ledger docs also state that Workflow 'stores validated definitions but does not execute them.'

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
